milestone: R7 Control-plane Authority and Completion Gates

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Keeps scheduled autonomous development decisions bound to the external automation authority instead of stale repo-local phase files.
Preserves the separation between controller authority and runtime product authority by preventing VSIX or repo task files from becoming policy owners.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development by making scheduled control-plane authority deterministic and guarded across context resets and fresh checkouts.
answers.new_capability: CI can now reject stale repo-internal phase-loop authority claims, stale Phase 3.4 live state, and old hard-stop rules before they steer autonomous planning or review.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: The existing diagnostics and phase-value guards validate wrapper/value-gate behavior but do not scan repo control-plane files for contradictory source-of-truth declarations.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Future runs can still follow obsolete `.brownie-control` or `.codex/tasks` instructions and stop or implement against stale state despite the external authority having advanced.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M49.1-M49.3 changed runtime Mode Pack run-control routing; R7.1 changes CI-enforced development-control authority.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase adds no JSON-RPC method.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The phase adds no runtime or VSIX summary/report surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Product runtime behavior does not change. Development-control behavior changes because CI enforces pointer-only repository authority and rejects stale live-state files.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A scheduled caller can trust repository control-plane files as pointers and rely on the external automation root for live state, reducing stale-stop and wrong-phase recovery failures.
answers.milestone_progress: This opens R7 by removing source-of-truth drift before the Product Completion Gate is implemented.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: R7.1 changes package/CI guard wiring and extends the phase-value guard engine file inventory. Review must confirm the new control-plane authority guard cannot silently weaken phase-value enforcement.

exit_criteria: repository control-plane files under `.brownie-control/` and `.codex/tasks/` are pointer-only and no longer encode live scheduled state
the control-plane authority guard fails on stale sole-source-of-truth wording, stale Phase 3.4 live state, stale PR 35 live state, and repo-local status hard-stop rules
the control-plane authority guard passes on the repository pointer files
CI runs the control-plane authority guard through the existing VSIX check path and runs guard tests through the root scripts
phase-value guard detects future changes to the new control-plane authority guard files as guard-engine changes
no new RPC, runtime product behavior, VSIX-owned controller policy, report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, inspection, or preview surface is added
behavior_evidence: Node guard fixture tests cover pointer-only acceptance and stale authority rejection
pnpm guard:control-plane-authority validates the real repository files
pnpm guard:phase-value validates the R7.1 current manifest and strict guard-engine review metadata
